# Zinn Digital Provider

Manage Zinn Digital hosting through the public API. Catalogue data sources need no credential; everything else uses a per-organisation API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    zinn = {
      source = "zinn-digital/zinn"
    }
  }
}

# api_key falls back to ZINN_API_KEY. Catalogue data sources work without one.
provider "zinn" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Per-organisation API key. Defaults to `ZINN_API_KEY`.
- `api_url` (String) API base URL. Defaults to `ZINN_API_URL`, then `https://api.zinndigital.com`.
- `org` (String) Organisation id to act on (sent as `X-Zinn-Org`). Defaults to `ZINN_ORG`; usually unnecessary because a key belongs to one organisation.
